title: Route-matching test mock must anchor patterns so list routes do not match detail paths
answers: test matches chat sessions list for single session path
matchPath mock in route hook test
how to test dynamic experiment route tab mapping
body:
Symptom: A test expecting the list tab gets the detail tab's result (or the reverse) for a path like /experiments/123/<list>/<id>.
Root cause: a matchPath mock that does not anchor the regex lets a list route pattern match a longer detail path.
Fix pattern: in useGetExperimentPageActiveTabByRoute.test.tsx the jest.mock of RoutingUtils replaces each ':param' segment with a non-slash matcher and wraps the pattern in ^...$. Keep the anchors when extending the mock; add a test case per detail route with arbitrary param values (e.g. /experiments/123/datasets/dataset-456).
Constraints: The mock covers only ':param' segments; it is not the real react-router matchPath. Tests for new routes should use concrete paths that exercise the param branch.
applies: Unit tests of useGetExperimentPageActiveTabByRoute in the experiment-tracking experiment-page hooks.
says: Opening a single chat session highlights the sessions list tab on the experiment page
The experiment page active tab shows list view instead of detail view for items
Viewing a specific dataset keeps the parent list tab selected in the experiment navigation
Make experiment navigation tabs distinguish between item detail screens and item collection views
search: In useGetExperimentPageActiveTabByRoute.test.tsx, the jest.mock of RoutingUtils matchPath must wrap route patterns in ^...$ anchors and replace :param segments with non-slash matchers so list route patterns do not match detail paths. Tests for new or extended routes must preserve these anchors and use concrete paths with arbitrary parameter values. The mock covers only :param segments rather than full react-router matchPath behavior.
